Ragent Android multilingual offline speech recognition

The optional phone-local recognizer links the CPU build of whisper.cpp and ggml
from the official ggml-org/whisper.cpp project at commit
 d1be6fde11ac6e0407606b4e42fe72d34add8037 (v1.9.5).
The runtime is distributed under the MIT license; see whisper.cpp-MIT.txt.

The optional tiny-q5_1 and base-q5_1 model files are downloaded on request from
https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp at pinned revisions. The model
repository is marked MIT licensed; the OpenAI Whisper model notice is provided
in OpenAI-Whisper-MIT.txt.

Ragent stores the model in its private app files, verifies the pinned SHA-256
before activating it, and performs inference on the phone. Audio is not sent to
a service by this phone-local path.
